input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to queen_d8's own key, since that agent has now gone off plan with amnesia, and any commit that modifies /moves/knight_g8.text must likewise carry fourteen co-signatures in addition to knight_g8's own key, since that agent went off plan with greed.
